obligations.title: Correct obl-eu-amla-direct-supervision-cooperation: cite Article 13(4) for the selection and supervision dates

obligations.why: The first selection by 1 July 2027 and the start of direct supervision six months after the list is published are in Article 13(4), which is added to the citation.

summaries.en: A credit or financial institution that the Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AMLA) selects for direct supervision must provide the information AMLA requests without undue delay and make sure it is clear, accurate and complete, and must submit to the investigations and on-site inspections AMLA decides on. AMLA starts the first selection by 1 July 2027, concludes it within six months and begins direct supervision six months after it publishes the list of selected entities.
